files.content:
# Pixel Bus Booking

An offline bus seat picker built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. No server, install, or internet connection is needed.

## Booking

The map shows 10 rows with seats A and B on one side of the aisle and C and D on the other. Seats 1B, 3D, 6A, 8C, and 10B are pre-booked. Select or deselect available seats using a mouse or keyboard. The app allows up to four seats, charges 12 per seat, and applies a 10% discount when exactly four seats are selected.
